question: What will be the value of 10 - [378 ÷ 6 of 9 - (25 - 72 ÷ 3)]?
solution:
**Given:**

10 - [378 ÷ 6 of 9 - (25 - 72 ÷ 3)]

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cc8f63640c17e5af9cdfc3b1e0aec219549b666eec21d379b8feb7bd6c52eb4.png] 

**Calculation:**

10 - [378 ÷ 6 of 9 - (25 - 72 ÷ 3)]

⇒ 10 - [378 ÷ 6 of 9 - (25 - 24)]

⇒ 10 - [378 ÷ 6 of 9 - 1]

⇒ 10 - [378 ÷ 54 - 1]

⇒ 10 - [7 - 1]

⇒ 10 - 6

⇒ 4

**∴ The required answer is 4.**
